editorial_review_row.content: eToro is a multi-regulated social trading pioneer scoring 7.4/10 from NAFT in 2026. FCA + CySEC + ASIC + FINRA regulated. CopyTrader remains the industry-leading social trading feature with 30M+ users. Real stock investing at 0% commission. Spreads wider than ECN brokers. 77% retail loss rate. Best for social/copy trading enthusiasts and real stock investors wanting a regulated all-in-one platform.
